assistant|dog_walker_platform: Rover connects dog owners with local dog walkers and sitters; browse profiles, read reviews, book online
Care.com offers pet care services including dog walking
Wag! connects with local walkers; book 30-min or 1-hour walks, track dog's route in real-time
Barkly Pets connects dog owners with local dog walkers and sitters
assistant|dog_walking_service: Pet Sitters International is a network of professional pet sitters and dog walkers across the US
NAPPS connects pet owners with local pet sitters and dog walkers
assistant|medication_administration_opti: Some dog walkers may administer flea/tick medication as an added service; ask about experience, certifications, comfort, and liability
Pet sitters often provide medication administration as part of more comprehensive care
assistant|dog_toy_recommendation: Kong Toy: hollow center can be stuffed with treats, peanut butter, or canned dog food
Tricky Treat Ball: treat-dispensing ball requiring rolling to release treats, adjustable difficulty
Puzzle toys like Nina Ottosson Dog Brick or Outward Hound Brick Puzzle challenge dogs to slide, lift, or rotate pieces
Interactive feeders like Outward Hound Sensory Maze or Pet Zone Treat Wobbler make meals challenging
Hide-a-Squirrel: plush toy with hidden compartments and squeakers for problem-solving
West Paw Design's Wobbler: weighted, treat-dispensing toy that wobbles and moves
Sensory mats like Snuffle Mat or Pawfect Pets Sensory Mat engage the dog's sense of smell
Tug toys with hidden treats like Tug-A-Jug or Ever Pet Interactive Tug Toy
Electronic toys like Petcube Bites or Furbo Interactive Dog Camera allow remote interaction and treat dispensing
DIY interactive toys can be made from cardboard boxes, paper bags, and treats
assistant|collar_brand_recommendation: Yellow Dog Design: stylish, comfortable, durable collars in nylon, leather, cotton with many patterns
Puppia: soft, comfortable, adjustable collars in cotton, polyester, nylon
Coastal Pet Products: durable collars in nylon, leather, rubber; martingale and breakaway styles
Ruffwear: durable, comfortable, adjustable collars suited for active dogs
assistant|collar_type_recommendation: Nylon collars: durable, easy to clean, variety of colors and patterns
Leather collars: stylish, durable, comfortable, develop a patina over time
Breakaway collars: release if caught on something, reducing injury risk
Martingale collars: tighten slightly when the dog pulls, preventing slip-out
assistant|name_tag_recommendation: Engraved name tags: durable, easy to read, customizable with name and contact info
ID tags with rivets: durable, stylish, customizable with name and contact info
assistant|dog_walker_referral_source: Ask friends, family, or neighbors for reliable dog walker recommendations
Local pet stores or veterinarians may recommend dog walkers
Community Facebook groups or online forums can provide dog walker recommendations
assistant|dog_walker_vetting_tips: Check reviews from multiple sources, conduct an interview, verify insurance and certifications, and get a meet-and-greet before hiring a dog walker
assistant|max|medication_administration_: If a walker administers medication, provide clear instructions on dosage and side effects, leave a schedule, and regularly follow up
A trusted neighbor or friend familiar with the dog could help with medication administration
Automated medication dispensers can be programmed to dispense medication at set times
assistant|max|kong_toy_usage_tips: Start with small amount of peanut butter, vary treats, freeze the Kong, add kibble layers, supervise, and rotate toys to keep engagement
assistant|max|collar_selection_considera: Consider comfort and adjustable fit, durability for active lifestyle, style, and safety (breakaway or martingale if needed)
